description.correction: Keycloak's Admin REST API manages realms, users, groups, clients, roles, sessions, and identity providers on an operator-hosted Keycloak server. Calls require a bearer access token with sufficient administrative roles or delegated permissions; the full realm-admin role is not required. Tokens may represent users or service accounts and can be obtained through supported OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect flows.

notes: The base URL is an official template, so HTTP 0 is expected until {host} is replaced. Current 2026 releases and documentation show the API remains active. The description incorrectly implies that every caller needs a realm-admin token; limited admin roles and delegated permissions are supported. No authoritative project documentation established global Admin REST quotas or CORS behavior.
